verdict.rationale: Pendo is a SaaS analytics platform with AI features (Leo, agent analytics), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of any control that excludes customer data from AI model training. Session-replay masking and the bulk visitor-deletion API are related privacy controls, but neither is a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
